about.title: About MaraLyrics
about.mission_p1: MaraLyrics is dedicated to preserving, documenting, and sharing the rich musical heritage of the Mara people. We believe that music is one of the most powerful expressions of culture, and every lyric tells a story that deserves to be remembered.
about.mission_p2: Our platform serves as a bridge between generations — making it easy for anyone, anywhere, to discover, learn, and enjoy Mara songs in their original language.
about.why_p1: The Mara language and its musical traditions are an integral part of our cultural identity. As communities modernize and disperse, there is an urgent need to document and preserve these artistic works before they fade from collective memory.
about.why_li1: Provide a free, accessible, and centralized collection of Mara song lyrics
about.why_li2: Support the preservation of the Mara language through music
about.why_li3: Celebrate the work of Mara artists and composers
about.vision_p1: We envision MaraLyrics as the definitive digital archive of Mara music — a living, growing repository that future generations can turn to for education, inspiration, and cultural connection.
about.vision_li1: Building the largest collection of Mara song lyrics online
about.vision_li2: Adding song audio and video references where available
about.vision_li4: Collaborating with cultural organizations and educational institutions
about.vision_li5: Empowering community members to contribute and curate content
about.community_p1: MaraLyrics is built by and for the Mara community. We welcome feedback, song submissions, and corrections from anyone who shares our passion for preserving Mara music. Together, we can ensure that our songs continue to inspire for generations to come.
about.community_p2: Want to get involved? Get in touch with us or send us feedback.
about.community_p3: Curious how the project is growing, or want to contribute code? See the project stats and contributors.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How accurate are the song lyrics on MaraLyrics?
faq.a1: We strive for the highest level of accuracy. All lyrics are sourced from original recordings, official publications, or trusted community members. However, some variations may exist between different performances or regional dialects. If you notice an error, please use our Report Error page to let us know.
faq.q2: How can I submit a song to MaraLyrics?
faq.a2:
We welcome song submissions from the community! To submit lyrics, please contact us with the following information:

  • Song title
  • Artist / composer name
  • Complete lyrics text
  • Category (Gospel, Love, Traditional, Patriotic, etc.)
  • Any additional context or notes

Our editorial team will review the submission and publish it once verified.
faq.a3: Yes! MaraLyrics is completely free. Our mission is to make Mara song lyrics accessible to everyone. The platform may display advertisements to support operational costs, but access to lyrics will always remain free.
faq.q4: Who owns the copyright to the lyrics?
faq.a4: The copyright of all lyrics belongs to their respective artists, composers, and rights holders. MaraLyrics displays lyrics for cultural, educational, and personal use only. We do not claim ownership of any song content. If you are a copyright owner and wish to request a removal, please visit our Copyright page.
faq.q5: How do I report an error in the lyrics?
faq.a5: You can report errors directly from the song page by clicking the "Send Feedback" button, or visit our Report Error page. Please include the song title and a description of the issue. Our team will review and correct it promptly.
faq.q6: Can I use lyrics from MaraLyrics for my project?
faq.a6: Lyrics on MaraLyrics are shared for cultural and educational purposes. For personal, non-commercial use (such as learning, singing, or study), you are welcome to reference the content. For any commercial use, please contact the original rights holders. Please see our Terms & Conditions for full details.
faq.q7: Does MaraLyrics collect my personal data?
faq.a7: We collect minimal data necessary to operate the platform. This includes basic analytics (page views) and information you voluntarily submit through our forms (name, email). We never sell your data. For full details, please read our Privacy Policy.
faq.a8:
You can support us by:

  • Sharing MaraLyrics with friends and family
  • Submitting song lyrics or corrections
  • Providing feedback through our Contact page
  • Spreading the word about Mara music and culture

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_content: MaraLyrics ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website at maralyrics.com and its associated subdomains (the "Site"). Please read this policy carefully. By using the Site, you consent to the practices described herein.
privacy.s2_content:
2.1 Information You Provide

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you:

  • Submit a contact form (name, email address, message)
  • Submit a feedback or error report (name, email address, feedback details)
  • Contribute song lyrics or content

2.2 Automatically Collected Information

When you access the Site, we may automatically collect certain information, including:

  • Browser type and version
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited and time spent on pages
  • Referring website address
  • IP address (anonymized where possible)
  • Device type and screen resolution
privacy.s3_content:
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on the Site:

  • Essential Cookies: Required for core site functionality, such as language preferences and theme settings. These are stored in your browser's local storage.
  • Analytics Cookies: We may use third-party analytics services (such as Cloudflare Web Analytics) to understand how visitors interact with the Site. These tools collect anonymized usage data.
  • Advertising Cookies: We display advertisements through third-party vendors, including Google. These vendors use cookies (such as the Google Ads cookie) to serve ads based on your prior visits to this Site and other websites on the Internet, so that the ads shown to you are more relevant. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings, or opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info/choices.

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain features of the Site.
privacy.s4_content:
We use the information we collect to:

  • Operate, maintain, and improve the Site
  • Respond to your inquiries and communications
  • Process and review feedback and error reports
  • Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience
  • Display relevant advertisements
  • Ensure the security of the Site
privacy.s5_content: Your data is stored on secure servers operated by Cloudflare, Inc. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s6_content:
We may use third-party services that collect, monitor, and analyze data. These include:

  • Cloudflare: DNS, CDN, security, and analytics
  • Google AdSense: Advertisement display and management. Google and its partners use cookies to serve ads based on your visits to this Site and/or other sites. You can learn more about how Google collects and uses data at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.
  • Cloudflare Turnstile: Bot detection and spam prevention

These services have their own privacy policies, and we encourage you to review them.
privacy.s7_content:
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access, correct, or delete your personal data
  • Object to or restrict the processing of your data
  • Withdraw consent at any time
  • Request a copy of your data in a portable format

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@maralyrics.com.
privacy.s8_content: The Site is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.
privacy.s9_content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the Site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
privacy.s10_content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

info@maralyrics.com

copyright_page.title: Copyright & Removal Request
copyright_page.s1_content: MaraLyrics respects the intellectual property rights of songwriters, composers, and artists. Our platform exists to preserve and celebrate Mara musical heritage, and we are committed to handling all copyright matters responsibly and promptly.
copyright_page.s2_content:
All song lyrics displayed on this Site are the intellectual property of their respective songwriters, composers, and rights holders. MaraLyrics does not claim ownership of any song lyrics. Lyrics are provided for personal, cultural, educational, and archival purposes only.

The website design, code, branding, and original content (excluding lyrics) are © 2026 MaraLyrics. All rights reserved.
copyright_page.s3_content:
If you are a copyright holder (or authorized to act on behalf of one) and believe that your copyrighted work has been posted on MaraLyrics without authorization, you may submit a removal request. Please follow the steps below:

1

Identify the Content

Provide the specific URL(s) of the page(s) containing the copyrighted material you wish to have removed.

2

Provide Your Identity

Include your full legal name, relationship to the copyrighted work (songwriter, composer, publisher, authorized agent), and contact information.

3

Include a Statement

Provide a statement that you have a good faith belief that the use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.

4

Send Your Request

Email your complete removal request to:

info@maralyrics.com
copyright_page.s4_content:
• We will acknowledge receipt of your request within 48 hours.
  • We will review and verify the claim promptly.
  • If the claim is valid, the identified content will be removed within 7 business days.
  • You will be notified once the content has been removed.
copyright_page.s5_content:
• Fraudulent or bad-faith removal requests may be subject to legal consequences.
  • We may reach out for additional information or clarification before processing a request.
  • If you believe content was removed in error, you may contact us to file a counter-notification.
copyright_page.s6_content:
For copyright-related inquiries, please email:

info@maralyrics.com

For general inquiries, visit our Contact Us page.
